etym.s: fr. प्र + 2. अञ्च्; nom. प्रा॑ङ्, प्रा॑ची, प्रा॑क्; cf. Pāṇ. vi, 1, 182

spans.s: directed forwards or towards, being in front, facing, opposite, RV.; VS.; AV.; Mn. (acc. with √ कृ, to bring, procure, offer, RV.; to stretch forth [the fingers] ib.; to make straight, prepare or clear [a path] ib.; [also with प्र-√ तिर्, or -√ नी] to advance, promote, further, ib.; with Caus. of √ कॢप्, to face, turn opposite to, Mn. vii, 189)
turned eastward, eastern, easterly (opp. to अ॑पाच्, western), RV. &c. &c.
being to the east of (abl.), Mn. ii, 21
running from west to east, taken lengthwise, KātyŚr.
(with विश्वतः) turned to all directions, RV.
inclined, willing, ib.
lasting, long (as life), AV.
(esp. ibc.; cf. below) previous, prior, former
pl. (प्राञ्चस्) the people of the east, eastern people or grammarians, Pāṇ. i, 1, 75 &c.
(प्र-अञ्ज्˚), n. paint or cement (on an arrow), AV.
(prob. fr. प्र + अञ्जलि and = प्राञ्जलि) straight, Suśr.
upright, honest, sincere, ĀpŚr., Sch.
level (as a road), Kād.
प्राञ्जल—ता f. straightness, plainness (of meaning), Pañcat.
mf(इ, ई)n. joining and holding out the hollowed open hands (as a mark of respect and humility or to receive alms; cf. अञ्जलि, कृताञ्ज्˚), Mn.; MBh. and &c.
pl. N. of a school of the Sāmaveda, Āryav. (also -द्वैत-भृत्; v.l. प्राज्वलना द्वैत-भृतः and प्राजला द्वैत-भृत्याः).
प्राञ्जलि—प्रग्रह mfn. holding the hands joined and outstretched, R. (v.l. ˚लिः प्रग्र्˚).
प्राञ्जलि—स्थित mfn. standing with joined and outstretched hands, ib.
(MBh.) = प्राञ्जलि.
प्राञ्ज˚लिन् (Hariv.) = प्राञ्जलि.
प्राञ्जली-√ भू to stand holding out the joined and hollowed open hands, Kāraṇḍ.
